turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good morning, Sofia! How is your Monday starting out in Phoenix? Have you had a chance to do any sourdough baking recently?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Morning! It's starting off pretty well. I'm just sitting here waking up with a mug of standard brewed coffee from the pot. No sourdough baking this weekend, though, I needed a little break from the kitchen!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nothing wrong with a classic cup of coffee to kick off the week! Are you about to head out for your shift at the clinic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually just arrived! I decided to go on foot today instead of my usual drive in the hybrid. It's just a one-off thing because the morning weather was absolutely perfect, so I couldn't resist walking.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a beautiful way to start the day, especially since Phoenix mornings can get hot so quickly. Did you listen to anything on your walk?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I put on that audio series for learning Italian to get some practice in. It really made the time fly.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a fantastic way to practice, especially alongside the online course you signed up for. How are you finding the language so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's challenging but really fun. The pronunciation is tricky, but listening to the dialogue during my walk really helps it stick.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Repetition is key! Is Tom trying to learn any of it with you, or is he leaving that to you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He's leaving most of it to me, though he's learned a couple of food words already! We've been busy planning the wedding for next summer anyway, so he has plenty on his plate.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes sense, wedding planning is practically a part-time job! I hope you have a great day at the clinic today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you! I'm about to log in now. Talk to you later!
